short_description: Portable evolutionary ecology research: evolve plant strategies from causal environment/history, export deterministic research SpeciesCatalog artifacts, and prove self-organized transfer, environmental generalization, causal adaptation and replication before bounded simulator integration.
purpose: Build a reusable autonomous evolutionary ecology pipeline in which evolution produces portable lineage/species hypotheses, population ecology remains truth, and new landscapes are colonized and adapted through causal ecology rather than biome species tables or asset scatter.
